notes.title: The Grand Ball on Sale Now!
notes.notes:
Check out The Grand Ball your invitation is here!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23115646/95970470b0f47e993f7fcb034c819475beaff78e.png[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/632290/The_Grand_Ball/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

“The Grand Ball” is a Visual Novel like none other that will whisk you away on your most indulgent Victorian dreams. Choose your own adventure and see which of the eight endings you end up with!

notes.title: One Last Chance Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with Distant/Do nothing type choices
- Fixed issue with some users unable to save on more first slot.
- Other small changes and performance tweaks.

Thanks everyone for your patience and support. Its been eventful Last Lotus first release. We have learned many lessons about steam processes and procedures.

Last Lotus

notes.title: Deluxe Edition Special Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
We are very pleased to be releasing "One Last Chance" today.

There should be a deluxe package available which includes Soundtrack and Art Book. However it is not showing in our store page at the moment. We apologise as this is the first Last Lotus visual novel there are some stumbling blocks.

Hope you enjoy introduction to our visual novels and also enjoy making the choices in this brief touching romantic encounter.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/avatars/1a/1ace209581ff1462daad5977d62996dcf4fe523a_full.jpg[/img]
